rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: tv_iterations=400, tv_n_iter=400, tv_lambda=0.01, tv_step=0.5, tv_outer_wall_s=1500, val_n=5, train_n=0, rationale=TV-iter iter-3: iter-2 had a silent config-merge bug — the solver reads tv_iterations (default 200), not tv_n_iter (the agentic-cfg key). Set BOTH keys to 400 so the override actually lands. Hyp from iter-2 stands: if iter-1 (200 actual iters, hr=0.0108) is undercooked, doubling to 400 ACTUAL iters lifts hr into the 0.015-0.025 range. If hr < 0.012, TV plateaued at iter-1.
